Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
Episodes.Plot: Veteran Sergeant John Basilone ships out soon after Pearl Harbor for Guadalcanal while other young enlistees are sent to boot camp.

Episodes.Title: Basilone
Episodes.Writer: Bruce C. McKenna, Robert Leckie, Eugene Sledge
Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
Episodes.Plot: Outmanned and with supplies low, Basilone and other marines on Guadacanal rally to repel superior Japanese forces.

Episodes.Title: Melbourne
Episodes.Writer: George Pelecanos, Michelle Ashford, Robert Leckie
Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
Episodes.Plot: After arduous months in Guadalcanal, exhausted Marines are given rest and recreation in Melbourne, where they find the girls friendly and the beer cold.

Episodes.Writer: Robert Schenkkan, Graham Yost, Robert Leckie
Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
Episodes.Plot: After leaving Melbourne, the weather works against the leathernecks as Leckie falls seriously ill and Sledge gets assigned to New Britain.

Episodes.Writer: Laurence Andries, Bruce C. McKenna, Robert Leckie
Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
Episodes.Plot: Basilone's fame keeps him in the U.S. selling war bonds, Leckie rejoins his company, and Sledge is reunited with Phillips in Pavuvu.

Episodes.Writer: Bruce C. McKenna, Laurence Andries, Robert Schenkkan
Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
Episodes.Plot: Water is in short supply and the stifling heat takes control on Peleliu as Leckie is wounded and evacuated.

Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
Episodes.Plot: Sledge finds the carnage and death of his companions on Peleilu increasingly difficult to bear as Basilone continues his bond drive in the States.

Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
Episodes.Plot: Frustrated with his bond selling tour, Basilone goes back to training troops and, after marrying a pretty Marine sergeant, leads his men at Iwo Jima.

Episodes.Title: Okinawa
Episodes.Writer: Bruce C. McKenna, Robert Leckie, Eugene Sledge
Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
Episodes.Plot: The 1st Marine Division fight a determined Japanese force on Okinawa who prefer death to surrender and are indifferent to the lives of Okinawan civilians.

Episodes.Actors: James Badge Dale, Joseph Mazzello, Jon Seda
